{{Quote|This is us. Thanks Freck.|The stormtrooper|<ref name="Kenobi III" />}}
A [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> [[Gender|male]] '''stormtrooper''' was active on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]]<ref name="Kenobi III" /> in [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] is set ten [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' must be set in [[9 BBY]].</ref> Taking a lift in the back of [[Freck]]'s [[FMR-385 cargo speeder|mining repulsortruck]], the [[stormtrooper]] and his [[squad]] had a passing encounter with the [[farmer]] "Orden" and his daughter "Luma," in actuality the [[Jedi]] [[Great Jedi Purge|fugitive]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Kenobi III" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[stormtrooper]] first appeared in "[[Part III]]" the third episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]. He is portrayed by [[Shane Hartline]].<ref name="Kenobi III" />
